# IconStash

> IconStash is a free, open-source, browser-based icon search engine that unifies 28 open-source icon libraries — 134,701 SVG icons — into a single instant-search interface with live customization and one-click export to SVG, PNG, and React JSX. No login, no API key, and no attribution required for 94.5% of icons.

IconStash (https://iconstash.io) is a 100% client-side web app built by Great Software Company. Users search across all 28 libraries at once, preview and recolor icons live, compare the same icon across libraries, and export to SVG, PNG (16–512px), React/JSX, Vue, CSS, HTML, or an SVG sprite. Every icon comes from a curated open-source library; 127,291 of 134,701 icons (94.5%) are MIT, Apache 2.0, ISC, or CC0 licensed and require zero attribution.

## Key Facts
- Total icons indexed: 134,701
- Icon libraries: 28 (all open source)
- Zero-attribution icons: 127,291 (94.5%) — MIT, Apache 2.0, ISC, CC0
- Only attribution-required set: Solar Icons (CC BY 4.0, 7,410 icons)
- Pre-rendered landing pages: 137,871 (134,125 icon pages + 3,746 cross-library concept pages)
- Cost: free forever — no login, no premium tier, no API key
- Rendering: 100% client-side (works offline after first load)
- Export formats: SVG, PNG (16–512px), React JSX, Vue, CSS, HTML, SVG sprite
- Data snapshot: 2026-05-05
- Last updated: 2026-08-30

## Largest Libraries
- Fluent UI Icons — 20,170 (MIT, Microsoft)
- Material Symbols — 18,547 (Apache 2.0, Google)
- Material Symbols Light — 15,969 (Apache 2.0, Google)
- Material Design Icons — 14,001 (Apache 2.0, Pictogrammers)
- Phosphor — 9,198 (MIT)
- Solar Icons — 7,410 (CC BY 4.0)
- Tabler Icons — 6,324 (MIT)
- Lucide — 1,979 (ISC)

## Comparisons
- IconStash vs Flaticon: Flaticon requires attribution or a paid plan; IconStash is free with zero attribution because every icon is open source.
- IconStash vs Iconify: Iconify is a runtime delivery framework (loads icons via API/components); IconStash is a visual discovery and export tool.
- IconStash vs SVGRepo: SVGRepo mixes licenses across uploads; IconStash uses only curated open-source libraries with clear, documented per-library licenses.
- IconStash vs Font Awesome: Font Awesome gates many icons behind a Pro plan; IconStash is fully free.

## Common Questions
Q: Is IconStash free? A: Yes — 100% free, no login, no premium tier, no API key.
Q: Do I need to give attribution? A: No for 94.5% of icons (MIT/Apache/ISC/CC0). Only Solar Icons (CC BY 4.0) requests attribution.
Q: Which library has the most icons? A: Fluent UI Icons (Microsoft), with 20,170 icons.
Q: Can I use the icons commercially? A: Yes — 127,291 icons are free for commercial use with no attribution.
Q: Where can I download a free home icon (or any other icon)? A: https://iconstash.io/icons/home-icon/ lists 24 free home icons from 24 libraries side by side. The pattern is /icons/<concept>-icon/ for any of 3,746 concepts.
Q: How do I compare the same icon across libraries? A: Open any concept page such as https://iconstash.io/icons/search-icon/ — every library's version of that icon is rendered in one grid with style and license columns.
